symptom: ako/mxcli#2111: a combo box whose Editable is 'based on attribute value' was described as a bare `Editable: Conditional` — no condition — and check refused it (MDL-WIDGET19), so describe -> exec of AgentCommons.MCPView_New, SingleMCPTool_Edit and Tool_NewEdit failed.
cause: Forms$ConditionalEditabilitySettings carries the same Attribute / Conditions / SourceVariable as its visibility twin (gen metamodel), but mxcli modelled only its Expression: describe read nothing else, MDL had no spelling, and the writer wrote only the expression. Attribute-based visibility had been built end to end earlier; editability never was.
file: mdl/executor/cmd_pages_describe_parse.go, cmd_pages_builder_visible_when.go (attributeConditions, applyEditableWhen), mdl/backend/modelsdk/widget_write.go (conditionalEditabilityToGen), mdl/grammar/domains/MDLPage.g4, sdk/pages/pages_widgets.go
insight: When a stored setting prints as a bare enum value ('Conditional') the condition it names is being dropped by the reader — compare the metamodel's fields for the settings type against what describe reads. Twin settings (visibility/editability) should share one resolver; here attributeConditions serves both. Every key allowlist (native props, replace baselines, engine system keys, MDL-WIDGET52 owned-elsewhere) needed the new key, which only the describe -> check round trip found. Verified on TestApp: text boxes and a combo box, context and $Param forms, check passes, describe -> exec Unchanged, mx check 0 errors.
